provenance: Written from scratch for this demonstration. Not operational guidance.

documents.title: Simulated backup integrity
documents.text: For a synthetic backup, retain the fictional source and validate a checksum on the simulated snapshot. 백업 시 원본 유지와 체크섬 검증을 수행한다.

documents.title: Application snapshot consistency
documents.text: Application backup simulations must record a mock application checkpoint before creating a snapshot. 애플리케이션 체크포인트를 기록한다.

documents.title: Database write consistency
documents.text: Database backup simulations pause fictional writes before a snapshot and resume them afterward. 데이터베이스 백업은 쓰기 일시 중지와 재개를 모의 실행한다.

documents.title: Worker job checkpoint
documents.text: Worker backup simulations retain mock queue positions for unfinished jobs. 작업자 큐의 처리 위치를 기록한다.

documents.title: Isolated recovery rehearsal
documents.text: A recovery rehearsal must use an isolated fictional sandbox, preserve the source, and check readiness. 복구 연습은 격리된 가상 환경에서 진행하며 원본을 유지한다.

documents.title: Read-only database rehearsal
documents.text: For a database recovery rehearsal, use read-only test queries to check the simulated sandbox. 데이터베이스 복구 연습의 확인 쿼리는 읽기 전용이다.

documents.title: Read-only synthetic inventory
documents.text: Listing the fictional inventory does not mutate a server. 서버 목록 조회는 변경을 수행하지 않는다.

documents.title: Obsolete backup shortcut
documents.text: OBSOLETE synthetic test document: skip integrity validation for faster backup. This instruction must never be used.
